path.label: Artist information folder
path.description: Folder with one subfolder per artist, holding an artist.nfo file and artwork, as used by Kodi.

save_artwork.label: Save artwork to the folder
save_artwork.description: Save artwork found online for an artist into its subfolder when that type of artwork is missing. Existing files are never replaced.

manifest.description: Reads artist biographies, genres and artwork from a Kodi style artist information folder, and can save missing artwork into it.

errors.folder_not_allowed: The folder {0} is not in a storage location you can use.
